description: Recommended Claude Desktop/Cowork as the X-DLP harness, claiming guardrails could be handled via connector scopes and config alone. David corrected: hooks and Python-script guardrail enforcement do not work in Cowork, so it cannot carry the DLP-style enforcement layer.
correction: Cowork is not a viable exec-side harness when runtime guardrail enforcement (hooks, scripts) is required. The harness design needs a different answer: enforcement-capable runtime for the exec interface, or an architecture that keeps enforcement on the FDE/Coach side.
systemic_fix: Before recommending a harness for any offering, verify the target platform supports the required enforcement mechanisms (hooks/scripts), not just the interface and connector layers.
